report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current telemetry contradicts it: gateway metrics show error_rate 0.001 and p95 75ms, gateway logs show status 200 ok, and order traces show OK. The only anomaly is order retained heap after GC (WARN x6, retained_after_gc true), which is insufficient to establish a memory leak. No evidence supports a bounded root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Sustained memory-retention time series for order showing monotonic growth across multiple windows
Order heap usage trend and GC frequency to distinguish leak from steady-state retention
Confirmation of actual checkout error-rate/latency elevation matching the alert
Downstream dependency latency/error data for order (inventory, payment, postgresql)
